preconditions.description: The number of gifts n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each gift's pleasantness a_i must be an integer between -10^9 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct gifts with valid IDs.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' if not possible else stdout == str(max_sum)
postconditions.description: If it's impossible to choose gifts without fighting, print 'Impossible'. Otherwise, print the maximum sum of pleasantness.
The maximum sum of pleasantness must be non-negative.
The possibility of choosing gifts without fighting is determined by whether the maximum sum is greater than zero.
